text: 2026年全国食品安全宣传周主场活动22日在京举办，中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理张国清出席并讲话。张国清强调，要严格落实“四个最严”要求，坚持抓在日常、严在平时，下更大功夫狠抓食品安全全链条监管措施落地。要全面压紧压实各方责任，强化产储运销等各环节监管无缝衔接，督促生产经营主体严把原料准入关、产品出厂关和生产经营全程控制关，督促平台企业和检测认证机构严格履行责任，确保食品质量安全可靠。
text_en: The main event of the 2026 National Food Safety Awareness Week was held in Beijing on the 22nd, with Zhang Guoqing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attending and delivering a speech. Zhang Guoqing emphasized the need to strictly implement the "four strictest" requirements, persist in daily and routine strictness, and make greater efforts to ensure the implementation of full-chain food safety regulatory measures. It is necessary to fully compact and压实 responsibilities of all parties, strengthen seamless connection of supervision in all links including production, storage, transportation, and sales, urge production and operation entities to strictly control raw material access, product ex-factory, and full-process production and operation control, urge platform enterprises and testing and certification institutions to strictly fulfill their responsibilities, and ensure reliable food quality and safety.
